appDescription: An app for preparing and sharing road condition reports with approaching drivers.

function.name: CREATE_ROAD_NOTE_DRAFT
function.description: Prepare a road condition report draft without publishing it to other drivers.

content.description: The road condition observed by the user.

locationMode.description: The location handling intent: nearby current road for an immediate observation, an explicitly named place, an unclear location requiring clarification, or explicit deferral for later placement.

placeQuery.description: The explicitly named place and its spatial qualifiers for location lookup.

directionMode.description: The direction reference: the reporting vehicle's current travel direction, a direction explicitly described by the user, or an unknown direction.

directionDescription.description: The user's explicit description of the affected road's travel direction.

utteranceRecordedAt.description: The original report utterance start time captured by the speech system, in ISO 8601 UTC format, when available as measured metadata.

draftId.description: The app-issued identifier returned for an existing draft being continued.
